headline: Shalibhadra Finance reduces its incremental cost of borrowing
hook: Cost of funds drops at Shalibhadra
summary: Shalibhadra Finance Limited issued a press release on October 29, 2026, announcing a reduction in its incremental cost of borrowing. The company informed the stock exchange about this development regarding its funding expenses. Lower borrowing costs can improve net interest margins for non-banking financial companies. Retail investors should track if this translates to better profitability in upcoming quarterly results.
why_it_matters: Lower borrowing costs could improve margins for Shalibhadra Finance.

headline: Shalibhadra Finance board approves Rs 24 crore NCD issue
summary: Shalibhadra Finance Limited announced that its board of directors met on October 13, 2026, and approved the issuance of non-convertible debentures amounting to Rs 24 crores. The company informed the stock exchange regarding this outcome. Such debt issuances are typically used by non-banking financial companies to fund operations and lending activities. Retail investors in the company should note this debt mobilization as part of the firm's capital management strategy.
why_it_matters: New debt issuance alters the capital structure for shareholders

headline: Shalibhadra Finance Company Secretary Megha Singh resigns
summary: Shalibhadra Finance has announced the resignation of its Company Secretary, Megha Singh. The resignation is set to take effect on October 1. The company has not yet disclosed a successor for the role.
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no immediate impact on stock performance.

headline: Shalibhadra Finance files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Shalibhadra Finance Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a standard corporate governance and compliance filing following shareholder deliberations. For an Indian retail investor holding the stock, this procedural disclosure ensures transparency on resolution outcomes but has no direct financial impact on share price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share value.
